description: Convert overworld into Aether II-style continental floating islands. Vanilla ores, structures, and mobs are remapped into the islands via Isekai API. Coexists with bridge/airship mods. NeoForge 1.21.1.

mods.name: Sky World
mods.description: Turn the overworld into a vertical sea of floating islands. Three altitude tiers - broad sparse continents low down, a dense mid-level band that is where you live, and small rare stepping stones high above - with vanilla ores, structures and mobs remapped into the island volume via Isekai API. Requires Isekai API.

releases.notes:
## [2.1.0]

Requires Isekai API 2.2.0.

### Fixed
- Islands below the topmost one in a column now get ore and stone variants
  too. `ore_strategy` previously resolved only against the highest island in
  a stacked column, so anything floating above a lower island left it with no
  ore at all.
- Amethyst geode exposure is back to its previous level. Isekai API 2.2.0's
  fix above increased geode exposure 1.797x as a side effect; `rarity_filter`
  is retuned (160 → 288) to cancel it out.

### Added
- Below island depth 12, stone turns to deepslate variants
  (`isekai_api:strata`) — deepslate ores generate there instead of the
  regular ones.
